notes.title: Persona 5 Royal Ver. 1.04
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Persona 5 Royal! Please see release notes for Persona 5 Royal version 1.04:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash at the start of the game or during gameplay
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a significant drop in FPS when switching screens
[/list]
The patch will automatically be applied when the game is launched.

Thank you again for your continued support of Persona 5 Royal!

tags.bug: Fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash at the start of the game or during gameplay
Fixed an issue that caused a significant drop in FPS when switching screens
